messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for streaming-proxy eu-west2. p99 is 2.8s (target 1.5s). SLO breach. Auto-pager -> @oncall. Metrics: streaming_tail_stalls↑, tls_handshake_errors↑, tcp_retransmit_rate↑
oncall: Ack. I'm up. Grab me the primary graphs (tail/p95/p99, egress NAT metrics, conntrack, tcp retransmits).
raj_p: Looking at traces now. Something odd with egress TLS handshakes — spike around 18:01. Backend model hosts responding normally (cpu/mem fine).
emma_k: Grafana snapshots: https://grafana.local/d/streaming/egress?orgId=1&from=4898765400&to=4898765480 (p95/p99 panels) :eyes:
liam_s: Running tcpdump on streaming-proxy nodes in eu-west2-a. Quick snippet:
```
sudo tcpdump -n -i eth0 'tcp[tcpflags] & (tcp-syn) != 0' -c 50
18:01:02.123456 IP 10.2.3.45.52344 > 35.194.12.7.443: Flags [S], seq 12345, win 64240
18:01:02.223789 IP 10.2.3.45.52344 > 35.194.12.7.443: Flags [S], seq 12345, win 64240 (retransmit)
```
liam_s: Lots of SYN retransmits to NAT egress IPs. SRTT high.
maria_g: conntrack on nat-gw-1: conntrack table at 96% (max 65536). Many ephemeral ports in TIME_WAIT. ops-bot flagged ephemeral exhaustion earlier in weeks.
ops-bot: Possible ephemeral port churn + NAT scaling lag. NAT autoscale didn't spin due to cooldown window.
peter_h: Also seeing TLS handshake errors in front-proxy logs: "tls: handshake failure: remote error: tls: no renegotiation" — but more telling is packet drops (ifconfig shows RX errors on the NAT interface).
support-bot: Customer signals: 34 customers with >5% session failures in window. Two enterprise customers (org-123, org-789) opened live tickets reporting streaming stalls. CS is triaging.
raj_p: Hypothesis: NAT gateway(s) in eu-west2-a are overloaded (conntrack + ephemeral port exhaustion) causing retransmits and TLS handshake retries -> tail stalls. Need quick mitigation: steer a percentage of egress to nat-gw-2 (eu-west2-b) and scale up nat pool.
emma_k: Agreed. Suggested immediate mitigations in order: 1) Fail traffic to nat-gw-2 via route-weight update 2) Increase conntrack table size on nat-gw1 temporarily 3) Force NAT autoscale by temporarily increasing threshold
liam_s: I can update routing weights. Command (AWS example):
```
# shift 30% traffic to eu-west2-b
aws ec2 replace-route-table-association --association-id rtbassoc-xxxx --route-table-id rtb-xxxx --transit-gateway-attachment-id tgw-attach-bbbb
# (apply carefully, 30% via BGP community or route-target depending on infra)
```
liam_s: Pushing route change now (rolling 30% to nat-gw-2).
ops-bot: Note: before we change, ensure nat-gw-2 conntrack capacity is available. If not, we risk moving overload.
peter_h: nat-gw-2 conntrack at 40% — safe. Proceed.
liam_s: Done. Verified egress path metrics show drop in syn retransmits on nat-gw-1 and corresponding increase on nat-gw-2.
emma_k: Also bumped conntrack on nat-gw-1 to 131072: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=131072`. Watch for memory.
maria_g: After steering and bump, p99 dropped to ~1.6s in 45s. p95 back near target. Streaming tail stalls decreasing.
support-bot: Updating customer tickets with mitigation note and ETA for full fix. CS posted to org-123 and org-789.
raj_p: Next: long-term: fix NAT autoscale cooldown, increase ephemeral port range, and add egress-steer fallback to another AZ automatically when conntrack>90%. Create follow-up ticket.
oncall: I'm going to hand off to @emma_k for the rest of the window. Summary for next oncall: root cause likely nat-gateway conntrack/ephemeral exhaustion + interface RX errors leading to TLS handshake retries and retransmits. Mitigations performed: egress steering to nat-gw-2 (30%), conntrack bump on nat-gw-1, triggered manual nat autoscale. Current state: p99 ~1.5s, streaming tail stalls trending down. Customer impact: 34 customers affected, 2 enterprise alerts.
emma_k: Taking over. Will monitor for 30m, open follow-up infra PRs for autoscale and runbook updates. TO-DOs before close: 1) Add alert for conntrack >85% 2) Increase ephemeral port range on NAT hosts 3) Run soak test for egress failover 4) Postmortem template draft.
support-bot: CS noted customers queued for status update in 15m.
incident-bot: Incident moved to "mitigated" state by oncall at 4898765489. Incident channel will remain open for postmortem drafting. :white_check_mark:
